answers.how: Initially, the ball centers are approximately 133 px apart. A ball diameter of 53 px gives 5.72/53 cm per pixel, so the distance is about 14.3 cm.
From 1.00 to 2.00 s, the white ball moves approximately 243 px. Its average velocity magnitude is 243 × (5.72/53) / 1.00 ≈ 26.2 cm/s.
Between 0.88 and 1.12 s, the orange ball moves approximately 54 px. The centered velocity estimate is 54 × (5.72/53) / 0.24 ≈ 24.2 cm/s.
In the final frame, the purple and black ball centers are approximately 163 px apart. Multiplying by 5.72/53 cm per pixel gives about 17.6 cm.
A quadratic fit to the left yellow ball's center positions around 2.00 s estimates an acceleration magnitude of approximately 46 px/s². Converting with 5.72/53 cm per pixel gives about 5.0 cm/s².
